title: On Polluting the stream for miles below
subtitle: 垃圾处理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 垃圾处理（人与自然·环境保护·废物与处理）
meta: 主题语境：垃圾处理（人与自然·环境保护·废物与处理）　|　核心词汇：pollute　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pollute 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the grower ① polluted the stream for miles below twice over, and every buyer in the greenhouse said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three summers on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the grower ② pollutes the stream for miles below year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ pollute the stream for miles below at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ polluted the stream for miles below before — a line in the ledger for August 1951 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Polluting the stream for miles below twice over, the grower said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the crate at the far shelf, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ pollute the good name of the village year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Pollute the good name of the village at once and never mention it again.

By 1964 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new buyer from the next greenhouse ⑧ pollutes the good name of the village twice over every summer without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the shelf, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ polluted the stream for miles below again when nobody else would.

⑩ To pollute the stream for miles below, my mother said in 1969, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the greenhouse remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the greenhouse forgets, somebody pollutes the stream for miles below year after year again and somebody must pollute the stream for miles below twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 污染（一般过去式 polluted the stream for miles below：1957 年种植户头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 污染（一般现在 pollutes the stream for miles below：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 污染（不定式 to pollute the stream for miles below：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 污染（过去完成时 had polluted the stream for miles below：1951 年八月的收成账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 污染（动名词 polluting the stream for miles below 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 玷污（pollute the good name of the village：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去玷污村子的好名声）
G. v. 玷污（pollute the good name of the village：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 污染（后段两处：新来的收购人照例 pollutes the good name of the village，而母亲又一次 polluted the stream for miles below）

answers.why: pollute 意为“污染”，1957 年种植户来回两遍污染把下游好几英里的溪水污染了，那是大棚里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 polluted。
pollute 意为“污染”，自那以后种植户年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 pollutes。
pollute 意为“污染”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯污染把下游好几英里的溪水污染了”，此处为不定式 to pollute the stream for miles below。
pollute 意为“污染”，收成账里 八月 那行字说明早在 1964 年之前就有人污染过，故用过去完成时 had polluted。
pollute 意为“污染”，种植户说“污染把下游好几英里的溪水污染了这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 polluting the stream for miles below 作主语。
pollute 意为“玷污”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去玷污村子的好名声”，should ever 之后用原形 pollute the good name of the village。
pollute 意为“玷污”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻玷污村子的好名声（pollute the good name of the village at once），以后再也不要提起。
pollute 意为“污染”，新来的收购人每个夏天都照例玷污村子的好名声，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 pollutes。
pollute 意为“污染”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍污染把下游好几英里的溪水污染了，用一般过去式 polluted 叙述。
pollute 意为“污染”，结尾那句是母亲 1969 年的话：要污染把下游好几英里的溪水污染了，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和大棚记住的那一件。

items: 1957 年，种植户来回两遍污染把下游好几英里的溪水污染了；大棚里每一个收购人都说这是头一回。（polluted the stream for miles below）
多年以后，种植户仍年年地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（pollutes the stream for miles below）

早在 1951 年就有人污染把下游好几英里的溪水污染了，八月那天收成账上的一行字就是证据。（had polluted the stream for miles below）
种植户说过，来回两遍污染把下游好几英里的溪水污染了这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（polluting the stream for miles below 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻玷污村子的好名声，以后再也不要提起。（pollute the good name of the village，祈使句）
answers: In 1957 the grower polluted the stream for miles below twice over, and every buyer in the greenhouse said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three summers on, the grower still pollutes the stream for miles below year after year without being asked.
My mother said later that to pollute the stream for miles below at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had polluted the stream for miles below long before 1964, and the line in the ledger for August proves it.
Polluting the stream for miles below twice over, the grower said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 pollute 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1957 the grower polluted the stream for miles below twice over, and nobody in the greenhouse forgot it.
Even now the grower pollutes the stream for miles below year after year whenever the greenhouse asks.
Polluting the stream for miles below twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever pollute the good name of the village year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new buyer from the next greenhouse pollutes the good name of the village twice over every summer, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother polluted the stream for miles below again, and the greenhouse remembered that half.
